full_sentence: Unless the defendant can produce documentary proof, the court will almost certainly enter judgment against him.
sentence_stem: Unless the defendant can produce documentary proof,
correct_completion: the court will almost certainly enter judgment against him.
acceptable_variants: judgment will very probably be entered against him.
the case will almost certainly go against him.

options.text: the court has already entered judgment in his favour.
options.why_wrong: Stating a judgement already entered ignores the condition introduced by 'unless', which presents proof as a requirement not yet met.

options.text: so the evidence was rejected by the bench.
options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a consequence of something that has already happened, not the hypothetical result of an unmet condition.

options.text: the court will almost certainly enter judgment against him.
the defendant has already produced documentary proof.
options.why_wrong: This states the condition as already satisfied, which contradicts the 'unless' clause that frames it as an unmet requirement.

grammar_focus: Conditional clauses with 'unless' and a future result with 'will'
explanation: 'Unless' introduces a condition that has not yet been met, so the main clause must state the result that follows if the condition fails.
translation: Sanık belgeye dayalı kanıt sunamadığı sürece, mahkeme neredeyse kesinlikle aleyhine karar verecektir.
